name: What are the common plumbing fixture brands used by remodelers in the East Bay area?

mainEntity.name: What are the common plumbing fixture brands used by remodelers in the East Bay area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Remodelers in the East Bay area often work with a variety of reputable plumbing fixture brands to meet different aesthetic and budget requirements. Common choices include Kohler, Delta, Moen, and American Standard for faucets, showers, and toilets, known for their quality and availability of parts. For more high-end or specific design needs, brands like Rohl, Hansgrohe, or Dornbracht might be used. Your contractor can recommend brands that align with your remodel goals and budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: East Bay remodelers commonly use brands like Kohler, Delta, Moen, and American Standard for plumbing fixtures, with higher-end options also available.
